    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    marks=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bgc]
    X={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==bgc and o[i][j]==5}

    kp=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==bgc and o[i][j]==bgc]

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    out=[r[:] for r in g]

import os,re,collections,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Try parity-based rules on min manh distance per demo separately, and also per-marker assignment
for n in [2,3]:
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bgc=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h_,w_=len(g),len(g[0])
    marks=[(i2,j2) for i2 in range(h_) for j2 in range(w_) if g[i2][j2]!=bgc]
    print('demo',n,'markers',marks)
    for i in range(h_):
        line=''
        for j in range(w_):
            if g[i][j]==bgc:
                ds=[abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in marks]
                mn=min(ds); cm=min(max(abs(i-a),abs(j-b)) for a,b in marks)
                lab=int(o[i][j]==5)
                # check: recolored iff manhattan dist to nearest marker has specific relation to chebyshev
                cand = ((mn-cm)>=0 and ((mn-cm)%2==0))  # ring
                cand=False
                # test simple: recolored iff cell lies on a diamond band of fixed thickness around nearest marker
                line+=str(lab)
            else: line+='M'
        print(line)
